about:
# Easy Group Management

A small QoL mod that makes group management in group-heavy levels a little less annoying

## Features

* **Wasted Group Page** - you can check if you accidentally gave a group on an object(or trigger) and forgot to use it.
* **"Last Used"** button in "edit group" page - you can easily go to your last used group without typing it manually.
* **"0"** button in "edit group" page - mostly for mobile players :), sets current group to "0"
